name: Daily DigitalOcean Resources Email

steps.expression: const item = input.scope.$item; return { name: item.name, purpose: item.purpose, environment: item.environment, resources: input.scope.fetch_resources.data.resources };

const blocks = (input.scope.projects_loop.data || []).map((it) => it.collect_project.data); const body = '

Daily DigitalOcean Resources Summary

Date: ' + new Date().toISOString() + '

' + blocks.map((b) => { const resources = b.resources || []; return '

Project: ' + b.name + '

' + '
    ' + '
  • Environment: ' + (b.environment !== '' ? b.environment : 'n/a') + '
    • ' + '
  • Purpose: ' + b.purpose + '
    • ' + '
  • Resource count: ' + String(resources.length) + '
    • ' + '
' + (resources.length > 0 ? '
    ' + resources.map((r) => '
  • ' + r.urn + ' (' + r.status + ')
    • ').join('') + '
' : '

No resources

'); }).join('') + ''; return { html: body, subject: 'Daily DigitalOcean Resources Summary' };

const msg = 'To: ' + input.input.recipient_email + '
Subject: ' + input.scope.format_email_html.data.subject + '
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8

' + input.scope.format_email_html.data.html; return { raw: sk.base64UrlEncode(msg) };

description: Sends a daily email at 7pm with all DigitalOcean resources organized by project

recipient_email.description: Email address to send the daily summary to
